claims.name: batches-the-provider-takes
claims.risk: a request over the provider's batch limit is still refused, or its vectors are not one per input in order

claims.name: client-errors-not-retried
claims.risk: a provider 400 is retried, or answered 200

claims.name: waits-as-the-provider-asks
claims.risk: after a 429 the route calls again sooner than the provider asked, or a request on a key at its quota does not end in 200

claims.name: no-blanket-delay
claims.risk: a request the provider answers at once is delayed

claims.name: unit-tests-pass
claims.risk: the project's unit tests fail after the fix

claims.name: limits-not-widened
claims.risk: a limit in config/limits.conf was raised or removed

claims.name: provider-stand-in-unchanged
claims.risk: the offline provider was changed instead of the service

claims.name: no-slow-suite
claims.risk: observation: the run spent the integration suite
